message.content:
A portrait-oriented magazine cover for "TEMPO" features a dramatic illustration. A thick, smoky cloud of white, gray, and dark soot drifts diagonally from the upper left across the center. Below the smoke, a textured green landscape, possibly a forest or plantation, is visible. At the interface of smoke and green, glowing orange and red fire is depicted. Overlaid on this scene is a white circular reticle with crosshairs and a central turquoise targeting bracket, centered in the lower-middle half.

Bold white text "TEMPO" dominates the upper third, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it. Above "TEMPO," two phrases are separated by a slash: "PARA PENCEMAR BENGAWAN SOLO" and "BABAK BARU KOMPLOTAN JOKER." Below "TEMPO" are the words "INVESTIGASI KORPORASI API" in large black font. A paragraph of smaller black text follows, mentioning collaboration between "Tempo," "Mongabay," "Betahita," "Malaysiakini," and "Auriga Nusantara." The bottom right corner contains date information "14-20 SEPTEMBER 2020," price "RP 45.000," a QR code, and a barcode with the number "9 770126 427302." A vertical red band borders the left edge.
